pages.name: Reti: Accepted, 3.Qa4+
pages.notes: Plan had Be2 behind the e2-pawn and O-O without the Qxc4 recapture; plans generic. Rewritten with the numbered recaptures and ...Be6/...Nb6 gaining time on the queen.

pages.name: Reti: Advance, 3.e3
pages.notes: Plan had White playing d2-d4 onto Black's d4-pawn; the dxe3 plan was vague. Rewritten as a reversed Benoni after exd4 cxd4.

pages.name: Reti: Advance, 3.g3 c5 4.Bg2 Nc6 5.d3 e5
pages.notes: Plan had knight routes via e1 with the king there; overview called it a reversed King's Indian (it is a reversed Czech Benoni). Rewritten around b4, e3/f4 and ...f5.

pages.name: Reti: Advance, 3.g3 g6
pages.notes: Plan had a knight route e1-d3 with the king there; plan 4 vague. Rewritten around d3, b4/e3 and the c3/e3 squares.

pages.name: Reti: Advance, 3.g3 Nc6
pages.notes: Plan had a knight route via e1 to c2 with the king on e1. Rewritten around ...e5, Nd2/Rb1 and b4.

pages.name: Anglo-Polish Dutch
pages.notes: Plans read the e4-square as a move and suggested a ...g5 pawn storm. Rewritten around Bb2 on the long diagonal, the e4-square and ...a5.

pages.name: English Opening: Anglo-Scandinavian Defence
pages.notes: Overview called 2...Nf6 a pawn gambit (Black regains on d5) and plan had Nc3 harassing a queen not yet on d5. Rewritten with 2...Qxd5 3.Nc3 and 2...Nf6 lines.

pages.name: English Opening: Anglo-Scandinavian Defense, Löhn Gambit
pages.notes: Plan had ...Bxe6 before 3.dxe6. Rewritten around 3.dxe6 Bxe6 and 3.Nc3.

pages.name: English Opening: Myers Defense
pages.notes: Plan read the f5- and h5-squares as moves. Rewritten around d4 hitting g5 with the c1-bishop; reviewer rejections (the e8-h5 diagonal is not opened by ...g5; f5 can still be covered by ...e6) fixed and re-reviewed.

pages.name: English: 1...g6 2.e4
pages.notes: Plan had a d4-e4 route. Rewritten around King's Indian, Maroczy and Botvinnik transpositions.
